Grants users access to a project's contents.

Takes a list, because granting access is usually a group of people at
once. All-or-nothing on validation: an unknown name fails the whole
request rather than half-applying it, so the caller doesn't have to work
out which of their picks landed. Names already on the project are ignored,
so re-adding one alongside new ones is not an error.
